extra_development_v2.purpose: Group-E diversity seeds; frozen as a binary F0 decision

validation_v2.purpose: F2 checkpoint/configuration selection only; no training

f3_holdout.purpose: Sealed final holdout for F3 matched exam
f3_holdout.note: Generated and committed at F0 before any F1 data is seen

f4_holdout.purpose: Sealed holdout for F4 exam (generated at F0; used only if F3 fails)
f4_holdout.note: Domain separator committed at F0; seeds revealed only if F3 fails validly

derivation.method: deterministic PRNG from domain separator and integer index

guardrails: Development tools must reject any seed in validation_v2, f3_holdout, or f4_holdout
Training code must reject any seed not in its declared partition
Mixing rows from different seeds across partition boundaries is forbidden
